confidence_notes: Medium overall. The inexpensive meal, mid-range two-person meal, coffee and beer anchors rest on several aggregator figures that broadly agree. Vintages run from 2023 to 2026 and many are Numbeo- or user-submitted-derived; no Numbeo Delhi page was retrieved. The two-person mid-range meal has a plausible band of about 15-25 USD. Cocktail (set at about 2.8x the beer anchor, plausible 5-9 USD) and wine glass (set at about 2.3x the beer anchor, plausible 4.5-7 USD) are derived from beer because direct single-drink evidence was thin; undated hotel-bar menus were treated only as upper-end references. All four accommodation anchors are holistic knowledge-based estimates; no accommodation searches or live listings were checked (plausible bands: dorm 7-13, private hostel room 16-30, basic hotel room 16-30, 3-star room 50-85). INR figures were converted at about 95 INR per USD, taken from rate references in search results rather than an official quote. Tax and service treatment is not verified. The FX value is the latest RBA observation located (18 Nov 2026); no 19 Nov reading was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Inexpensive and mid-range meal, coffee and beer anchors are Delhi-specific aggregator figures where available, sanity-checked against India-wide averages, which sit well below Delhi restaurant prices. Cocktail and wine anchors are beer-relative. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates against Delhi's own hostel and hotel tiers.
